entities.summary: Jakub Radomir Kumoch is a Polish political scientist, journalist and diplomat, since 2023 serving ambassador to China. He previously served as the Head of the International Policy Bureau in the Chancellery of the President of Poland, and as the Polish ambassador to Turkey (2020–2021), as well as to Switzerland (2016–2020).
